infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: GestureConnect uses the camera to read your hand signs and translate them into text.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: GestureConnect uses the microphone to turn spoken words into sign language.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: GestureConnect needs photo library access so you can set a profile picture.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: GestureConnect saves sign language videos you export to your photo library.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: GestureConnect uses speech recognition to convert what you say into sign language.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: GestureConnect uses your location to suggest nearby sign language resources.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: GestureConnect connects to the sign language recognition server running on your local network.
